name: CI ingest
summary: Pulls JUnit XML from GitHub Actions artifacts and ingests per-test results. Playwright and Allure are named in the build plan and are not the primary path.
code_quality: Parser and upsert path are solid. Sync is capped at 50 workflow runs per repo.

name: Test identity
summary: Stable key plus alias table so a renamed test stays the same test. Auto-link at Jaccard 0.92 and confirm at 0.75.
code_quality: Small and deterministic. Matching is name and path text, so a rewritten test looks new.

name: Trust detectors
summary: Six result signals: never-failed, flake, retry-masked, skipped, permafail, signal decay, plus name-similarity duplicates.
code_quality: Thresholds are explicit. Flake means the same commit both passed and failed. Duplicate detection is name overlap and is labelled inference. Loads up to 50000 executions. Reads results only, not test source, and does not link a test to a ticket.

name: Today queue and rulings
summary: Bounded attention queue, reason-scoped rulings, and a suppressed-items drawer.
code_quality: Falls back to mock data when the org has no trust states, so an empty tenant looks populated.

name: Conventions
summary: Mines name and path shapes from the test corpus and can ratify or reject them.
code_quality: Keyword buckets such as checkout, wait, and directory name. A ratified pattern does not yet generate conformance findings.

name: Release certificate
summary: Counts verified, unverified, and unreliable tests and records ship, hold, or accept-risk.
code_quality: Honest aggregate of trust counts. Journey mapping and replay of an escape against individual tests are not automated. This is a release sign-off, not a pull-request merge gate.

name: Escapes
summary: Lists production misses.
code_quality: Display only. An escape is not replayed against the tests that should have caught it.

name: Jira key linker
summary: Extracts PROJ-123 style keys from commit and pull-request text.
code_quality: This is the ticket mapper that exists. It is string match. It does not judge whether the diff implements the ticket.

name: Ticket-commit evidence
used_by: Schema: TicketSnapshot, CommitSnapshot, EvidenceLink, EvidenceReview. Nightly recompute job.
summary: Scores ticket-to-commit candidates: direct key, author, date, keyword, and optional embedding.
code_quality: Nothing in the repo writes ticket or commit snapshots, so the nightly job skips. EvidenceReview is unused, so human accept or reject is absent. keyrefScore is hardcoded to 0. Author match is 40 percent of the non-direct score. No page reads EvidenceLink.

name: AI attribution classifier
summary: Labels a commit or pull request human_only, ai_assisted, ai_generated, or unknown from commit trailers and pull-request text.
code_quality: A diff over 300 added lines and under 50 deleted lines counts as an AI signal. Claude Code has no trailer of its own. There is no usage feed from Cursor, Copilot, or Claude. Confidence is a formula on signal count.

name: Pull-request risk and completion
summary: Deterministic flags: no review, large addition, no test file in the diff, no Jira key, low completion.
code_quality: enrich.ts fetches Jira issue text and then ignores it. Every completion score is the fallback, which starts at 50 when a key and a diff exist. Risk is forced to 0 unless the change is already labelled AI. No-test-delta only checks file paths in the diff excerpt.

name: Code-analysis sync
summary: Pulls up to 100 commits and 100 pull requests per repo over 90 days, with reviewers and a short diff excerpt.
code_quality: Real GitHub data. Accountability is three counts: unreviewed AI pull requests, unnamed reviewers, and high-churn paths. There is no per-pull-request summary, impact write-up, or suggested reviewer.

name: Compliance rules
summary: Six rules: unreviewed AI pull request, unlinked AI pull request, large AI commit, high-risk AI area, no test delta, low completion.
code_quality: Rules only fire on AI-labelled changes and restate the risk flags. They do not scan for vulnerabilities or security-standard deviations. Findings can be acknowledged or dismissed.

name: Delivery analysis
used_by: /delivery-analysis when a Jira project is connected
summary: Sprint completion, spillover, blocked and reopened work, and Jira hygiene discounts.
code_quality: Live Jira board health. It does not classify a pull request as feature, bugfix, or refactor, and it does not attach a later bug to the change that introduced it.

name: Incident-code correlator
summary: Links an incident to pull requests merged in the prior 72 hours. Score is higher when the deploy anchor matches.
code_quality: Time proximity plus service-name overlap. Returns people: author, reviewers, and Jira assignees. Does not read container logs, images, or a diff against the last good deploy.

name: Productivity metrics
summary: Per-contributor delivery table: pull requests, cycle time, reviews, story points, AI mix.
code_quality: The page is mock data from scripts/generate-productivity-mock.ts. A separate Mastra productivity agent persists ProductivityAnalysisRun rows, and the page does not read them. No AI credit cost.

name: Overview confidence
summary: Delivery-confidence gauge, trend, burndown, heatmap, and attention for leadership.
code_quality: Demo seed. The loader discards organizationId. The gauge is not computed from the trust ledger or from code analysis.

name: QA agent
summary: Runs four Jira presets: open bugs, blocked, open, done. Stores a board report.
code_quality: Different job from the marketing QA triangle. It does not link code, tests, and tickets. Instructions still say AIDOS organizationId.

name: Governance agent
summary: Clones a repo, indexes it, and reports hotspots and dead code.
code_quality: Repository health, not a policy over Cursor, Copilot, and Claude Code. /governance/toolchain-mapping is a sunset redirect.

name: DevOps AWS hygiene
summary: Assume-role inventory and hygiene checks, persisted when the agent runs.
code_quality: Not an incident investigator. No log, image, or deploy-diff path.

name: Prometheus and Grafana
summary: Sync and a metrics snapshot.
code_quality: Incident diagnosis does not call them. Empty state falls back to mock observability data.

name: DryDock LLM budget
summary: Daily token budget and response cache for this app's own LLM calls.
code_quality: Does not see Copilot credits, Cursor invoices, or Claude Code sessions.

name: Audit log
summary: Records actions DryDock itself took.
code_quality: Does not assemble a per-pull-request dossier of ticket, coding agent, security result, tests run, human approver, deploy, and outcome.

name: Approvals
summary: Human decision on a recommendation, with the recommendation's confidence copied onto the decision.
code_quality: AIDOS-era. Fixture data still backs the page when the overview fixture is on. This is not a merge GO or NO-GO.

name: Problem prediction
summary: Reads delivery history, code analysis, compliance, telemetry, deploys, and incidents.
code_quality: Early-warning UI is not a primary surface.

name: Embedding sidecar
used_by: Optional input to the evidence pipeline
summary: HTTP client to a Python sidecar using all-MiniLM-L6-v2.
code_quality: Evidence can pass those vectors in. Nothing fills the snapshots they would score. score(diff) exists and the completion enricher does not call it.

name: Code-test-ticket triangle score
summary: A score for how well code, tests, and the Jira ticket agree, for example (0.99, 0.98, 0.99), plus gaps in each direction.
code_quality: Three separate systems exist instead: trust counts on test runs, a Jira-key regex, and a completion fallback. No test-to-code linker and no test-to-ticket linker.

name: Pull-request review agent
summary: Review every new pull request as it opens: summary, impact, risky lines, and who should review it.
code_quality: Post-merge GitHub sync exists. No review agent and no reviewer router.

name: Merge GO / NO-GO
summary: A risk call before merge, with the coding agent named, and the human left as the decision maker.
code_quality: Risk flags are computed after merge. The certificate is a release sign-off.

name: Security agent
summary: A separate security check on every pull request for known vulnerabilities and insecure patterns.
code_quality: Six metadata compliance rules exist. No SAST or vulnerability scanner.

name: AI credit attribution
summary: Coding-tool credits tied to a pull request, ticket, sprint, and whether that work stayed stable. Cost per story point for coaching.
code_quality: No usage ingest from Cursor, Copilot, or Claude Code. Productivity shows an AI-mix column on mock data.

name: Per-change audit dossier
summary: One record per change for SOC 2: ticket, agent, checks, tests, approver, deploy, outcome, and visible gaps.
code_quality: Audit log of DryDock actions, plus compliance findings.

name: Incident log diagnosis
summary: Logs, container image, and deploy diff traced to pull requests, tickets, reviewers, coding agents, and tests.
code_quality: 72-hour pull-request window on an incident. Observability and AWS scans are separate and switched off in navigation.

name: Multi-agent governance
summary: One governance layer across several coding agents. The marketing answer says this still needs a brainstorm.
code_quality: Toolchain mapping page redirects away. The governance agent reports repository health.

name: Two data planes
used_by: Tests, code analysis, and Jira delivery are live. Overview and Productivity are mock.
summary: An empty org still shows a full Today queue because loaders fall back to mock briefing data.
code_quality: Buyers see the demo pipeline first. The live trust ledger is a different path.

name: Scores that look measured
location: classifier.ts; scoring.ts; incident-code-correlation.ts; overview score derivation
used_by: AI confidence, completion, incident confidence, overview gauge
summary: These numbers are formulas.
code_quality: The marketing triple score does not exist anywhere.

name: AI inference gates later rules
summary: Compliance and risk ignore changes that were not labelled AI.
code_quality: A bulky human commit can be marked AI because of its size, and then every downstream rule treats it as AI.

name: Fetched evidence is dropped
summary: Jira issue bodies are loaded during enrich and unused. Embeddings can be computed and the completion score never asks for them.
code_quality: The completion number therefore rests on key presence and a test-file path check.

name: Person data outside productivity
summary: Evidence scoring weights the commit author at 40 percent of the non-direct score. Incident links list authors and reviewers.
code_quality: Concept allows person metrics only on /productivity.

name: No automated tests
summary: No *.test.ts or *.spec.ts files.
code_quality: Detectors, the evidence matcher, and the AI classifier are pure functions and are unenforced.
